description: Pre-solicitation Notice For Webbers Falls Excitation System Replacements at Webbers Falls, OK This is a PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE for the Webbers Falls Excitation System Replacements in Webbers Falls, Oklahoma. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this pre-solicitation notice or any follow up postings. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers � Tulsa has been tasked to solicit for and award a contract for the Webbers Falls Excitation System Replacements, at Webbers Falls, Oklahoma. The proposed design-build project will be procured as an Unrestricted, firm-fixed price contract in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 15, Negotiated Procurement, using the Lowest Price Technically Acceptable approach. Tradeoffs will not be permitted. Project Description: This project includes the replacement of the excitation systems (including the Potential Transformers) for all units at Webbers Falls Powerhouse. The installation and commissioning of Unit 1 will be dependent on the availability of the unit, which is currently out of service due to issues with the speed gear. The Contractor will be responsible for designing and manufacturing the new excitation system equipment, delivering to the site, removing the existing equipment, installing the new equipment, and commissioning the new system. They will also perform model validation testing and reporting as listed above. The Hydroelectric Design Center (HDC) will provide submittal reviews, factory visit(s) to witness factory testing, and commissioning support to include determining draft settings for the excitation systems. The government will be responsible for landing all new cable (except for the AC cables from the bus tap to the Potential Transformers and the DC cables from the exciter to the brush rigging) to all external locations within the powerhouse, external to the new exciter and Potential Transformer cubicles. The estimated magnitude of construction for this project is between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. The North American Industry Classification System code for this procurement 237990 ( Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction) which has a small business size standard of $45M. The Product Service Code is: Z2KA (Repair or Alteration of Dams) Estimated duration of construction of this project is 300 calendar days. description: This is a notice of intent to solicit from a single source. The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), intends to award a purchase order to Elsys AG in Switzerland for a high-performance rack-mounted transient Data Acquisition Unit as described in the attached Required Specifications. Award will be made in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation FAR Part 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. Elsys AG is, to the USGS knowledge, the only source who can keep it consistent with existing equipment in the Rock Mechanics Laboratory. The requested procurement is necessary to ensure continuity, compatibility, and reliability of science. The current laboratory workflows depend on specific hardware and software configurations to ensure uniform performance across multiple workstations. Introducing a different model or brand would require duplicative training, additional maintenance contracts, and potentially custom integrations to align with existing systems. Purchasing matching equipment avoids these unnecessary costs and leverages existing institutional expertise. The purpose of this notice is to satisfy the requirements of FAR Subpart 5.203. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes. However, all responsible parties may submit a capability statement by the closing date of this announcement which shall be considered by the agency. No solicitation will be issued. title: Netherlands – Planting and maintenance services of green areas – Onderhoud van Interieurbeplanting 2026-2032
description: De interieurbeplanting draagt bij aan een groene, gezonde en frisse omgeving voor medewerkers en studenten. In de gebouwen van Windesheim staan hierom diverse interieurbeplanting. Om de kwaliteit van de interieurbeplanting op peil te houden, laat Windesheim periodiek onderhoud uitvoeren en planten vervangen wanneer deze de representatieve waarde heeft verloren.
